limitations.all_timed_calls_ns: dependent serial calls within fresh processes; process medians are the independent units
limitations.source_feature_graph: Canonical baseline/candidate feature sets compared independently; exact receipt is in qualification.
limitations.profiling: no profiling or artifact dumps admitted; phase timings are cold/setup phases
limitations.memory: Child high-water RSS includes compilation, setup and warmup; neither request-only RSS nor live Wasm heap.

qualification.limits: Affected integration/source scopes only. Full CI, pinned Test262 and private units were not rerun. Existing unmodified formatting and Intl identity gates remain owned.

evidence_archive.policy: Regular UTF-8 evidence only; no native executables, Wasm, perf.data or cache blobs. SHA256 INDEX covers every evidence member.
